description: Authored map for the admission of the third Chinese frontier-AI institutions collection (research/china-labs-3), read by scripts/china-labs-3-admission.ts. It applies the maintainer's decisions of 2026-10-30 (review note, questions 1-11) and the maintainer's adjudication of the cross-family check of 2026-10-31. Every entry carries its reason. Pack records not named here are admitted as the pack drafted them, with the mechanical schema fits the script applies (listed in the admission record).

1.snapshotDescription: Records as stored before part 1 of the admission of the third Chinese frontier-AI institutions collection on 2026-10-31 (no schema change; review/china-labs-3-admission-2026-10-31.md): the earlier metadata, the IDs part 1 added and the stored rows it changed, as they were. Changed rows: existing organisations that gained a legal name as an alias, and four existing StepFun role records that gained StepFun's own post as primary evidence (decision 8). The test-only historical view removes the added rows and restores the earlier metadata and rows.
1.scope: On 2026-10-31 a third collection of Chinese frontier-AI institutional histories was admitted from a machine-prepared, machine-audited and cross-family-checked candidate pack, under the maintainer's decisions of 2026-10-30 and 2026-10-31: model releases, licences, technical reports, filings, officers and documented investors of StepFun, 01.AI, iFlytek, SenseTime, Tencent (Hunyuan), the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence and Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory; the Beijing AI Principles and the Beijing AI Principles for Children as their texts state them, with the Chinese original of the former beside its English expression; the Cyberspace Administration of China's lists of filed generative AI services and deep-synthesis algorithms as dated listings with their count bases; and further provisions of TC260's AI Safety Governance Framework. Chinese passages are quoted in Chinese with machine translations. A listing is not an approval, a licence or framework states terms, not implementation, and a filing statement is the issuer's own account. Investors are recorded under the legal names the filings print, with no ownership or continuity inferred. All records remain seeds.

2.snapshotDescription: Records as stored before part 2 of the admission of the third Chinese frontier-AI institutions collection on 2026-10-31 (the schema change adding attributes.listedEntity; review/china-labs-3-admission-2026-10-31.md): the earlier metadata, the IDs part 2 added and the stored rows it changed, as they were. The test-only historical view removes the added rows and restores the earlier metadata and rows.
2.scope: On 2026-10-31 the second part of that admission added, under a schema that lets a participant-list record name one listed entity, eleven developers' entries in the Cyberspace Administration of China's lists of filed generative AI services: model name, filing entity, filing number and filing date as each row prints them, each at the earliest list in the collection's retrieval that contains it. The legal filing entity is recorded as printed and mapped to a dataset organisation with the basis of the mapping stated (exact alias, filing number, partial name or translation); no ownership or group structure is inferred, and a filing is not an approval or assessment. All records remain seeds.
